What this export can tell you

The addon walks _G over multiple frames. It records function paths, table paths and depths, primitive values, and other Lua types. The separate character capture runs curated getters and records their arguments and returns. Those observed calls appear under Character evidence; they are examples from one session, not exhaustive function signatures.

This environment includes the game API, UI internals, libraries and loaded addons. A familiar name or a namespace is not proof of a supported Forever API. Topic matches are name-based research leads, not confirmed character extraction capabilities.

Traversal stops at 100,000 entries and descends at most 15 levels. Tables are visited once, so aliases and depth limits can hide descendants. Strings are cut to 512 bytes; individual records identify truncation. A missing symbol is not proof that it is unavailable.

From discovery to evidence

Capture focused, explicitly reviewed character queries inside the addon with their arguments, return values, errors and client build. That evidence can grow this atlas into a documented Lua contract. Use OpenAPI when you introduce an HTTP service for your extracted character data; this snapshot itself has no HTTP endpoints.

Refresh this atlas

Run /api export for discovery or /api character for query evidence, wait for completion, then /reload to write SavedVariables. Copy the new dump and run the importer described in the project README.
